description: Total value locked read from DefiLlama: pass a protocol slug (for example aave) for that protocol TVL, or omit it to get the top chains ranked by TVL, or filter by one chain. Every figure is the aggregator value at the time of the call, with the source URL attached, and any missing section is listed in gaps. Use it for DeFi due diligence, chain comparison, or a quick read on where liquidity sits. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
name: defi-tvl
